title: 第6章
content_zh: 第六章 装可怜的兽兽“什么，你在说一遍！”皇帝以为自己听错了。“陛下，冷大将军把御药房的药材库搬空了。”小太监颤抖着跪在地上道，他知道他这次估计死定了，皇帝可是出了名的小气的，冷大将军这次可是让皇帝大出血了，要知道那药材库的药材可是数量不少的，除了普通药材外，还有不少名贵药材，皇帝可能不会为了普通药材心疼，可是那么多的千金难求的名贵药材……“你，你，那你怎么不拦着点！”皇帝怒道，脸都气绿了。“奴才，奴才，拦不住啊，冷大将军一下子拿出10多个储物戒指，奴才还没反应过来，那些药材就都被他装到戒指里了。”小太监真是欲哭无泪啊！“废物，真是一群废物，来人，把他拖下去。”皇帝怒火冲天地吩咐侍卫。“陛下请息怒，龙体要紧！”一旁侍候着的太监总管刘公公，小心翼翼地劝道，伴君如伴虎啊，就算他是皇帝身边的心腹，这种时候也得小心侍候着，丝豪不敢大意“冷擎天，真是歁人太甚！”皇帝咬牙切齿地道，他气的原本还算俊美的脸都有些扭曲了。“陛下息怒，奴才这算是看出来了，这冷擎天分明就是有备而来，算计陛下的，陛下是防不胜防啊！”刘公公讨好地道，他言外之意就是冷擎天早有准备，而陛下是被人算计了。“刘公公，你有什么好主意，替朕找回点面子？”皇帝一脸期待地，看着自己的心腹太监。“陛下，奴才认为此事得需从长计议，不过目前来说，陛下损失点钱财，大将军不在追究七皇子和徐小姐之事，这应该算是最好的结果了。”刘公公分析道，他知道皇帝最疼七皇子，所以很怕大将军会咬着自己孙女受伤的事不放。皇帝略微想了想“嗯，你说的很有道理，来人，摆驾盛芳宫。”“雷宵，今天咱们收获颇丰啊！”冷擎天在心里乐呵呵的和自己的灵兽交流心得，他的灵兽是一只九级圣兽飞天雷豹，雷、风双属性，擅长飞行，速度极快，攻击在圣兽中也是数一数二的。不擅言谈的雷宵，只是微点了点那硕大的头，算是对主人的回应了。“你主人我今天才发现，这打劫的滋味相当的不错啊，以后在有这样的机会，咱们主兽二个继续配合啊！”冷擎天在心里嚣张的大笑着。灵兽空间里面的巨大的黑色豹子额头滑下几条黑线，主人这打劫还打上瘾了，还要拉上它一起打劫，主人，它可是奉公守法的好兽啊，呜呜呜，主人这都是被小姐给带坏了，要知道，在它心里主人一直都是很正直地，今天之所以会这样算计皇上，可都是小姐教的，唉，它是看明白了，这个世上惹谁也别惹那个小祖宗。“小姐，为什么把我和绿桃姐姐打扮成这个样子？”翠竹看着镜中陌生的自己，一张平凡的即使放在人堆里也不容易认出的脸，很是不解。“这凤都中认识你们的人多吗？”冷若雪不答反问，流光益彩的美眸，在两人身上来回打量着，对自己的杰作很是满意。“当然多啊，凤都中没人不知道我和绿桃姐姐是冷大将军府的人！”翠竹道，要是不知道她们的身份，那些想欺负小姐的人怎么可能会忌惮。“那就对了，小姐我不想让别人认出你们。”冷若雪淡淡的道，她话已经说得很明白了，她们能明白最好，要是还不明白，她也懒得解释，她的身边不留无用之人。“小姐，绿桃明白了。”在翠竹还没反应过来的时候，绿桃连忙道，并用眼神示意翠竹噤声，免得引起小姐的不快。“那还不跟上。”冷若雪说完，转身朝门外走。三月的凤都，正是春暖花开的时候，而今天的天气又格外的清爽，风和日暖，阳光明媚，街上的行人熙熙攘攘，多的是成双成对的有情人，想来这东池国的民风还算开放，并不排斥自由恋爱，冷若雪一点点的打量着街上那些复古的建筑，琳琅满目的店铺，独属于这个世界的商品，心情也随之放松，甚至没有意识到她那倾国倾城的绝世容颜，在街上引起了怎样的风暴，更是没有察觉到一直注视着她的那道幽深的目光。冷若雪走进一家专卖宠物的店铺，她进来的时候看到店铺招牌上面有个风字，知道这是五大世家之中排名第二的风家的店，店铺面积不小，分为上下两层，一走进去，就会先看到几排架子，架子上面摆满了装宠物的兽笼，笼中一只只骄小可爱的兽兽或趴着，或站着，这些虽然都是做为宠物出售的，可是也都是灵兽，只不过等级比较低，外形又比较可爱，没有任何的攻击性，驯化又很容易，而且都是已经驯化好了的，并不需要契约，给一些贵族夫人、小姐当宠物最为适合。冷若雪非常喜欢小动物，特别是狗，她自己就曾经养过一只，只不过后来出了点意外，从那以后她就没养过任何的宠物，如今看到这些可爱的小东西，她也很心动，也想买一只来养，不过看来看去，除了她不认识的动物，就是各种各样的小兔子了，虽然很可爱，可是她却没什么兴趣。就在这时，她明显的感觉到有一道目光正在注视着她，她下意识的寻过去，看到一处有些偏辟的角落放着一个笼子，笼子里关了一只黑色的小动物，这是猫吗？说它是猫，是因为长得有点像波斯猫，可是它却有着一条狐狸一样的大尾巴，此时正趴在笼子里，大而圆的碧蓝色眼睛忧郁而又可怜兮兮地望着她，那目光真是让人不忍心拒绝啊！好吧，她承认她被萌到了，这可真是一只会装无辜装可怜的小东西，如果不是她捕捉到了这小东西眼中那快如闪电、一闪而逝的狡猾，也会被它给骗过去的。良久，自她走进这家店后，就一直处于迷离失神状态的店员，总算是回过神来，连忙走上前来，惊艳地看着冷若雪。“小姐，请问有什么需要帮助的吗？”店员非常有礼貌的轻声道，完全体现出了良好的职业素质。冷若雪指了指笼中的小家伙“它怎么卖？”“小姐要买它？这位小姐，不瞒您说，它现在身体状况不太好，恐怕活不了多久了，我们店里这么多可爱的宠物，楼上也有更好的，您不如换个？”店员苦口婆心地劝道，就差直接告诉她，不要买这个了。冷若雪有些好笑地看着热心的店员“我只要它，它怎么卖？”“小姐确定要买它？”“嗯。”冷若雪轻轻点了点头，这个小东西怎么可能就要死了呢，虽然它那黑色的绒毛看上去暗淡无光，小小的身子也瘦瘦的，看上去好像弱不禁风的，可是，冷若雪才不相信，它会是外表看上去的那么虚弱呢？“50个金币。”店员有些无奈道，他可是该说的都说了，这位小姐还执意要买，他总不能不卖吧，他可是没有违背风家做生意‘诚信为本’的宗旨哦！冷若雪示意绿桃付钱，之后从店员的手中接过看上去很是虚弱的小东西，转身出了这家店，又逛了一会。“‘春风楼？’那是饭店吧，我饿了，咱们去吃点东西。”冷若雪看着不远处，装修精致奢华的三层小楼道。“小姐，咱们换个地方吧，那里不好。”翠竹神色有些不自然的道。“不好？哪里不好了？我决定了，就这家了。”她是真饿了。“小姐……”这次就连绿桃都欲言又止，神色也不是很好。“给我个理由？”冷若雪美眸闪过一丝不悦地道，她讨厌饿肚子。“小姐曾经为了七皇子去过‘春风楼’，可是后来发生了一些事，那里便禁止小姐入内了！”绿桃小心翼翼的解释道，生怕小姐生气。又是那个该死的七皇子，冷若雪现在真是恨死那个讨厌的七皇子了，居然害她连个吃饭的地方都进不去，而这也注定了，那倒霉的七皇子日后的悲惨下场。“回府吧！”冷若雪是一点在外面吃饭的心情都没有了。回了将军府，吃过了饭，冷若雪慵懒地躺在躺椅上，怀中抱着同样吃饱喝足的小兽，晒着太阳，很是惬意。“绿桃，这凤都里还有哪些地方是不欢迎小姐我去的？”冷若雪一边吃着水果，一边随意地问道，顺便喂着她的小宠物。“只有徐家的产业，‘春风楼’也是徐家的。”绿桃解释道。“徐家吗？”很好，她记住了，敢招惹她冷若雪的人都会后悔的，冷若雪在心中腹腓着，手则轻轻的抚摸着小兽柔软的绒毛，突然，她感觉到自己的指尖一阵刺痛，那忘恩负义的小东西居然咬了她，不过她还没来得及发火，便感觉有些头晕目眩，接着便听到脑海中有个声音说“吾愿与汝签订‘灵魂本命契约’灵魂相随，生命同享，同生共死”接着华丽复杂的紫色契约阵法便将一人一兽笼罩在其中，契约正式成立。一旁的绿桃也有些傻眼“小姐…居然和一只低级灵兽契约了……”
content_en: Chapter 6 Pretending to be pitiful Beast "What, you are saying it again!" The emperor thought he heard wrongly. "Your Majesty, General Leng has emptied the medicinal materials warehouse in the imperial pharmacy." The little eunuch knelt on the ground tremblingly and said. He knew that he was probably dead this time. The emperor was notoriously stingy. General Leng made the emperor bleed this time. You must know the medicinal materials in the medicinal material warehouse. But there are a lot of them. In addition to ordinary medicinal materials, there are also many precious medicinal materials. The emperor may not feel sorry for ordinary medicinal materials, but there are so many precious medicinal materials that are hard to find... "You, you, why don't you stop it!" The emperor said angrily, his face turned green with anger. "Minion, minion, I can't stop you. General Leng took out more than 10 storage rings at once. Before the minion could react, he put all the medicinal materials into the ring." The little eunuch really wanted to cry without tears! "Trash, what a bunch of trash, come here, drag him down." The emperor ordered the guards angrily. "Your Majesty, please calm down, the dragon body is important!" Eunuch Liu, the chief eunuch who was waiting on the side, advised carefully. Accompanying the emperor is like accompanying a tiger. Even if he is the emperor's confidant, he must be carefully served at this time. Si Hao did not dare to be careless. "Leng Qingtian, you are really too cruel!" The emperor gritted his teeth, and his originally handsome face was distorted with anger. "Your Majesty, please calm down. I have seen this. This Leng Qingtian has clearly come prepared to plot against Your Majesty. Your Majesty is very unpredictable!" Eunuch Liu said flatteringly. The implication was that Leng Qingtian had been prepared for it, and His Majesty was plotted against. "Eunuch Liu, do you have any good ideas to save me some face?" The emperor looked at his confidant eunuch expectantly. "Your Majesty, I think this matter needs to be discussed in the long term. But for now, your Majesty will lose some money and the general will not pursue the matter of the seventh prince and Miss Xu. This should be considered the best result." Eunuch Liu analyzed. He knew that the emperor loved the seventh prince the most, so he was afraid that the general would not let go of his granddaughter's injury. The emperor thought for a moment, "Well, what you said makes sense. Come and show me to Shengfang Palace." "Lei Xiao, we have gained a lot today!" Leng Qingtian happily exchanged experiences with his spirit beast in his heart. His spirit beast is a ninth-level holy beast, the Flying Thunder Leopard, with both thunder and wind attributes. It is good at flying, extremely fast, and its attack is one of the best among holy beasts. Lei Xiao, who was not good at talking, just nodded his huge head slightly as a response to his master. "Your master, I just discovered today that the taste of robbery is quite good. If there is such an opportunity in the future, we two master beasts will continue to cooperate!" Leng Qingtian laughed arrogantly in his heart. A few black lines slid down the forehead of the huge black leopard in the spirit beast space. The owner became addicted to robbing, and even wanted to drag it along with him. Master, it is a good beast that abides by the law. Wuwuwu, the master was led astray by the young lady. You know, in its heart, the master has always been very upright. The reason why it plotted against the emperor today was all taught by the young lady. Alas, it has understood that no one in this world should mess with that little ancestor. "Miss, why are Sister Lu Tao and I dressed like this?" Cuizhu looked at her unfamiliar self in the mirror, with an ordinary face that was difficult to recognize even in a crowd, and was very puzzled. "Do many people in Fengdu know you?" Leng Ruoxue asked without answering, her beautiful eyes looking back and forth at the two of them, very satisfied with her masterpiece. "Of course there are many. No one in Fengdu knows that Sister Lu Tao and I are from General Leng's Mansion!" Cuizhu said. If they didn't know their identities, how could those who wanted to bully the young lady be afraid. "That's right, miss, I don't want others to recognize you." Leng Ruoxue said lightly. She had already made her words very clear. It would be best for them to understand. If they still don't understand, she didn't bother to explain. She doesn't keep useless people around her. "Miss, Lu Tao understands." Before Cuizhu could react, Lu Tao said quickly, and signaled Cuizhu to be silent with her eyes, so as not to cause the lady's displeasure. "Then why don't you keep up?" After Leng Ruoxue finished speaking, she turned around and walked out the door. In Fengdu in March, spring is when flowers are blooming, and today's weather is particularly refreshing, with warm wind and bright sunshine. The pedestrians on the street are bustling, most of them are couples of lovers. I guess the folk customs in Dongchi Country are quite open and do not exclude free love. Leng Ruoxue is a little bit excited. Looking at the retro buildings, the dazzling array of shops, and the unique products of this world on the street, I felt relaxed. I didn't even realize what kind of storm her stunning face had caused on the street, and I didn't notice the deep gaze that had been watching her. Leng Ruoxue walked into a store that specializes in pets. When she came in, she saw the word "Feng" on the sign of the store. She knew that this was the store of the Feng family, which ranked second among the five aristocratic families. The store was large and divided into upper and lower floors. As soon as she walked in, she would first see several rows of shelves. The shelves were filled with animal cages for pets, and the cages contained little and proud animals. The cute beasts are either lying down or standing. Although these are sold as pets, they are also spiritual beasts, but they are relatively low-level and have a cute appearance. They are not aggressive in any way and are easy to tame. Moreover, they are already domesticated and do not require a contract. They are most suitable as pets for some noble ladies and ladies. Leng Ruoxue likes small animals very much, especially dogs. She once raised one herself, but something happened later and she has not kept any pets since then. Now that she sees these cute little things, she is also very excited and wants to buy one to keep. But looking at it, apart from animals she does not recognize, there are all kinds of little rabbits.
